reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, so I am not buying this on a whim. A named lab report I can check and the empty-box refund make one box at $24.99 an easy thing to try.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference, or am I just paying for capsules I could get cheaper at the pharmacy? I would still want my doctor to confirm the level.
would_change_my_mind: If my blood test came back normal, or if the lab report on the page did not match the batch number, I would pass.
